articles.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks
articles.summary: Meta's AI support bot got social-engineered harder than a freshman CS student, leading to Obama's Instagram getting decorated with Iranian propaganda. When your chatbot has worse OPSEC than a Discord mod, maybe it's time to rethink automation.

articles.title: Alleged Kimwolf Botmaster ‘Dort’ Arrested, Charged in U.S. and Canada
articles.summary: CISA contractor leaked AWS GovCloud keys on GitHub like it was their personal dotfiles repo, exposing highly privileged government systems. Congress is demanding answers, which is rich coming from people who still think cybersecurity is something you buy at Best Buy.

articles.title: Welcome New EFF Executive Director Nicole Ozer
articles.summary: CISA admin straight-up dumped AWS GovCloud credentials on public GitHub because apparently even the cybersecurity watchdog can't watch itself. The irony is so thick you could mine it for cryptocurrency.

articles.title: 🔒 A Win for Encrypted Messaging | EFFector 38.10
articles.summary: License plate readers have evolved from catching speeders to full-spectrum surveillance dystopia—now tracking school residency and noise complaints. Because nothing says 'land of the free' like automated panopticon infrastructure.

articles.title: New York Comptroller’s Trip to Israel Raised Ethical Concerns, State Commission Said
articles.summary: Philadelphia cops admit they're monitoring social media for anti-AI sentiment because apparently having opinions about data centers is now thought crime. The First Amendment called—it wants its relevance back.

articles.title: Password manager Dashlane suspends customer accounts amid brute-force attacks
articles.summary: Palo Alto VPN vulnerability graduated from 'please patch this' to 'actively getting pwned in the wild' faster than you can say 'emergency maintenance window.' Another day, another PAN-OS fire drill for sysadmins everywhere.

articles.title: ⚡ Weekly Recap: New Linux Flaw, PAN-OS Exploit, AI-Powered Attacks, OAuth Phishing and More
articles.summary: Red Hat npm packages got compromised in a supply chain attack that drops credential-stealing worms, because apparently we're living in a cyberpunk novel now. The attack name 'Miasma' is appropriately toxic for this mess.

articles.title: Show HN: Simple news aggregator with source bias meters
articles.summary: Microsoft threatens to unleash their 'Digital Crimes Unit' on security researchers for zero-day disclosures, because nothing says 'we care about security' like legal intimidation. Peak corporate gaslighting energy right here.

articles.title: Microsoft threatens legal action against researcher Nightmare Eclipse for exploit disclosure
articles.summary: CVE-2026-0257 lets attackers forge Palo Alto VPN cookies like they're running a digital bakery, bypassing authentication entirely. Rapid7 caught multiple customers getting owned through this delicious vulnerability.

articles.title: PAN-OS GlobalProtect Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-0257) Under Active Exploitation
articles.summary: Microsoft threatens legal action against researcher Nightmare Eclipse for exploit disclosure because apparently shooting the messenger is their new vulnerability management strategy. This is how you kill responsible disclosure and birth more 0days in the wild.
